blocks.html: Talk to Grubfoot in the Dorgeshuun Mines.
blocks.text: Talk to Grubfoot in the Dorgeshuun Mines.

options.text: Mistag, why won't you let Grubfoot into the city?

substeps.html: Dismiss any familiar or Grubfoot won't follow you.

blocks.html: With Grubfoot following, enter Dorgesh-Kaan using the door to the south and head north-west where Oldak is.
blocks.text: With Grubfoot following, enter Dorgesh-Kaan using the door to the south and head north-west where Oldak is.

blocks.html: In the north-west room, talk to Zanik.
blocks.text: In the north-west room, talk to Zanik.

options.text: So why have you come to talk to Zanik?
How do you know your dream was true?
I promise not to tell anyone where the temple is.

needed.html: Black mushroom ink or a vial
needed.text: Black mushroom ink or a vial

recommended.html: An extra vial or Black mushroom ink
recommended.text: An extra vial or Black mushroom ink

recommended.html: An extra toadflax potion (unfinished) to make a second potion. (Or, you can attempt to save a dose from your first potion)
recommended.text: An extra toadflax potion (unfinished) to make a second potion. (Or, you can attempt to save a dose from your first potion)

blocks.html: If you forgot to bring the toadflax potion, proceed until Zanik has entered into the temple.
blocks.text: If you forgot to bring the toadflax potion, proceed until Zanik has entered into the temple.

substeps.html: Otherwise, you will need to go back to Oldak in Dorgesh-Kaan to meet with her, and provide him two law runes and one molten glass.
substeps.text: Otherwise, you will need to go back to Oldak in Dorgesh-Kaan to meet with her, and provide him two law runes and one molten glass.

blocks.html: Once you teleport with Zanik, head north-west to the temple entrance blocked by two goblin guards.
blocks.text: Once you teleport with Zanik, head north-west to the temple entrance blocked by two goblin guards.

substeps.html: Pick and grind a black mushroom into an empty vial if you don't already have black mushroom ink.
substeps.text: Pick and grind a black mushroom into an empty vial if you don't already have black mushroom ink.

blocks.html: Talk to the guards and they will allow Zanik to pass into the temple.

blocks.html: Talk to the Makeover Mage south-west of Falador.
blocks.text: Talk to the Makeover Mage south-west of Falador.

options.text: Can you turn me into a goblin?
I need to slip past some goblin guards.
Can you turn me into a goblin or not?

blocks.html: Use the pharmakos berries on an unfinished toadflax potion to create the goblin potion.
blocks.text: Use the pharmakos berries on an unfinished toadflax potion to create the goblin potion.

substeps.html: (Optional) After making the potion, collect another set of pharmakos berries if planning to complete the Contract Claws mystery.
substeps.text: (Optional) After making the potion, collect another set of pharmakos berries if planning to complete the Contract Claws mystery.

blocks.html: Head to the goblin cave (just north of the Ardougne lodestone).

blocks.html: Unequip all items and dismiss any followers.
blocks.text: Unequip all items and dismiss any followers.

blocks.html: In front of the goblin guards, drink the goblin potion (pick any goblin appearance).

blocks.html: Climb down the entrance.
blocks.text: Climb down the entrance.

blocks.html: North, sitting on his throne, talk to the High Priest.
blocks.text: North, sitting on his throne, talk to the High Priest.

options.text: Can you tell me about Yu'biusk?
I understand the ways of the Big High War God.

blocks.html: Take the quiz.
blocks.text: Take the quiz.

options.text: The Big High War God commands it.
Goblins were not mighty warriors before he chose us.
Lead goblins to victory over the whole world.

blocks.html: After the quiz, ask about Yu'biusk.
blocks.text: After the quiz, ask about Yu'biusk.

options.text: Can you tell me about Yu'biusk?

blocks.html: Dye your goblin mail black with the mushroom ink.

blocks.html: Pickpocket the priest for a key. Keep this key. You will need it later.

blocks.html: Search the crate in the room to find the teleport sphere.
blocks.text: Search the crate in the room to find the teleport sphere.

blocks.html: Talk to Zanik in the prison cell to the north-west of the crate, she will teleport.
blocks.text: Talk to Zanik in the prison cell to the north-west of the crate, she will teleport.

options.text: I have a teleport sphere here.

blocks.html: Leave the cave.
